title: Persona: Schema cleanup, canonical skills, mechanical weaknesses, apparent age, and secret ownership
goal: Align the Persona schema and compiler with ViWo simulation mechanics and privacy/observability boundaries

sections.what: Clean up persona schema fields and compiler outputs that conflict with ViWo simulation invariants.
sections.why: Freeform skills produce dead strings like drywall_patching, role_in_town is boilerplate, secrets.known_by lives on the wrong character, and exact age leaks in observable descriptions.
sections.how: Restrict capabilities.skills to canonical Player.skills keys, add mechanical weakness hooks, deprecate role_in_town, move secret sharing to knower memories, render apparent age bracket in base_description, and keep deepest_secret internal-only.
sections.verify: pytest tests/test_character_appearance.py -q and npm run build:ts

acceptance.text: capabilities.skills constrains/maps to the 18 canonical checkable skills while non-mechanical crafts live in expertise or interests
capabilities.weaknesses wires mechanical liabilities such as nearsighted perception penalty without glasses
narrative.role_in_town is deprecated/removed from compiled description and UI
narrative.secrets.known_by is replaced by an init-time memory seeder on the knower rather than runtime metadata on the subject
Compiled observable base_description shows apparent age bracket rather than exact numeric age, and deepest_secret informs internal prompt tension without leaking into observable prose

custom.browser_ui: Persona tab renders canonical skill picker/levels for capabilities.skills, mechanical liability hints for weaknesses, drops role_in_town, and shows apparent-age preview.
